description: Defines types and interfaces related to session management, including session origin, identity, metadata, runtime options, session entries, and related utility functions for handling session data in a project.

methods.name: normalizeRuntimeField
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string value or returns undefined if the result is empty.

methods.name: normalizeSessionRuntimeModelFields
methods.description: Normalizes the model and provider fields in a session entry by trimming and removing empty values.

methods.name: setSessionRuntimeModel
methods.description: Sets the runtime model and provider fields in a session entry if valid.

methods.name: resolveMergedUpdatedAt
methods.description: Determines the updatedAt timestamp for a merged session entry based on policy.

methods.name: mergeSessionEntryWithPolicy
methods.description: Merges two session entries with optional policy and timestamp handling.

methods.name: mergeSessionEntry
methods.description: Merges two session entries with default policy.

methods.name: mergeSessionEntryPreserveActivity
methods.description: Merges two session entries while preserving activity timestamp.

methods.name: resolveFreshSessionTotalTokens
methods.description: Returns totalTokens if it is a finite, non-negative number and marked as fresh.

methods.name: isSessionTotalTokensFresh
methods.description: Checks if totalTokens in a session entry is considered fresh.
